summary: Weber's October 2023 statement condemned the attack on Israel while expressing sympathy for civilians on both sides and calling for an end to the conflict and its underlying causes. CAIR Action endorsed her in the general and Vote for Peace rated her an Ally, providing concrete stance evidence beyond her own words. The record contains no statement in which she names the situation genocide or calls for ending U.S. military aid to Israel.
